title: Java 27 Delivers Post-Quantum Cryptography, Future Language Innovation, Helidon 27, JavaFX 27
full_text:
Oracle has released version 27 of the Java programming language and virtual machine. As the second non-LTS release since JDK 25, the final feature set includes nine JEPs, five of which are still progressing through the preview and incubator stages. This release focuses on strengthening security, future language innovation, and projects under the auspices of the Java Verified Portfolio.

By Michael Redlich

title: Presentation: Teaching Engineers, Trusting AI: How Education Enabled Autonomous Code Review
full_text:
Sarah Deitke discusses how Duolingo drives cultural AI adoption beyond tooling access. She explains their internal AI literacy workshops and observability dashboards, then shares a case study on redesigning code review using an automated PR risk-assessment bot. Deitke demonstrates how pairing targeted developer education with safe AI guardrails speeds up delivery without increasing defect rates.

title: Jev: The ChatGPT Co-Creator's System One Model Can't Talk
full_text: Diogo Almeida, who co-invented RLHF and InstructGPT at OpenAI, spent two years building Jev: a System One model that cannot generate text, only typed decisions with calibrated confidence. TypeSafe AI prices input at $0.042/MTok, output free, running 70-500ms. Automation needs a model it can trust, not one that talks.
